radiology_report:
Subject: Prostate mpMRI
Institution: OLVG, Amsterdam
Date: 18 February 2025
Clinical context: Assessment of elevated PSA (6.6 ng/mL) alongside a PI-RADS 4 designation.

Findings: Glandular volume registers at 30.37 mL. T2 sequences highlight a discrete hypointense focus within the left mid-gland peripheral zone, spanning 12 by 9 mm. DWI shows pronounced diffusion restriction with matching low ADC values. DCE captures prompt, localized enhancement. Capsule integrity remains intact without seminal vesicle involvement. Staging clears nodal and osseous sites of suspicious activity.

Impression: PI-RADS 4 lesion located in the left mid-gland peripheral zone, dimensions 12 x 9 mm. Prostate volume 30.37 mL. PSAD 0.217 ng/mL/mL. csPCa predicted probability 0.6730961.

previous_notes.text: Primary care monitoring recorded a PSA reading of 2.8 ng/mL. The individual reported zero lower urinary tract complaints and maintained regular farm duties. A subsequent PSA check was slated for the first quarter of 2024.
